entries.name: Butter Bridge
entries.description: Butter's bridge endpoint. Inbound messages from the MAP relay chain need a proof that the verifier accepts and become pending payments. After the release delay, a payment that is not frozen is released from the reserve with release signatures for the reserve to check. Relaying, releasing, freezing and all configuration are restricted by the authority.

authority.description: AccessManager that decides who can call the restricted functions, upgrades included.

verifier.description: Contract that checks the proof of each inbound message.

reserve.description: Contract that holds the liquidity and pays out released payments.

releaseDelay.description: Seconds between an inbound message and the earliest release of its payment, the window to freeze it.

failedReceiver.description: Receives a payout when the transfer to the recipient fails.

relayMos.description: Bridge contract on the MAP relay chain that messages are sent to.

entries.name: Butter AuthorityManager
entries.description: OpenZeppelin AccessManager-derived authority for the restricted functions of the Butter contracts that name it. Its role configuration controls who can change their validation, token and fee settings, pause them and upgrade them.

adminRole.description: Members of ADMIN_ROLE can reconfigure the AuthorityManager itself, including role membership and the function-to-role mappings that govern attached Butter contracts.

entries.name: Butter Verifier
entries.description: Verifier of inbound Butter Bridge messages from the MAP relay chain, running unverified code. Its getters name a signer set and a quorum.

entries.name: Butter AuthorityManager
entries.description: OpenZeppelin AccessManager-derived authority for the restricted functions of the Butter contracts that name it. Its role configuration controls who can change their validation, token and fee settings, pause them and upgrade them.

adminRole.description: Members of ADMIN_ROLE can reconfigure the AuthorityManager itself, including role membership and the function-to-role mappings that govern attached Butter contracts.

entries.name: Butter Reserve
entries.description: Liquidity reserve of the Butter Bridge on Base, running unverified code.

entries.name: Butter FeeService
entries.description: Fee configuration contract used by Butter Bridge to calculate cross-chain message fees and select the fee recipient.

authority.description: Authority contract consulted by FeeService management functions. Its role members can change fee parameters and the fee receiver.

feeReceiver.description: Current recipient returned by FeeService for message fees collected by the Bridge.

baseGasBase.description: Base gas component used by FeeService when pricing messages to Base. Authority members can change this value.

baseFeeInfo.description: FeeService's current Base/WETH pricing tuple: base gas, gas price, and fee receiver. Authority members can change the pricing inputs and receiver.
